title: The Haunted House Noises on Hubbard Street

scenes.narration: Baffling police for more than two weeks, mysterious noises at seventy Hubbard Street in Milwaukee hit the local evening newspapers. This is a true story.
On Monday, November seventeenth, nineteen nineteen, the usual three sharp taps on the cold windowpane sounded as loud as ever before.
Inside the quiet residence lived Mr. and Mrs. J. H. Graus right alongside Mr. and Mrs. J. M. Marzi.
A full automobile load of seasoned detectives rushed quickly through the dark streets to the active scene to investigate.
Yet the supposed ghost that the officers eagerly sought was simply not in evidence anywhere.
Detectives sat inside the tense house for a very long time trying to locate the hidden source.
With zero answers found, what would you check first in an empty room like that tonight?
